moves.name: Mozambique Drill
moves.text: Destroys ballistic Protection; on Dominance, also a head injury.

moves.name: Judo Throw
moves.text: Ignores the protection type (e.g. a vest) and throws the opponent Prone.

moves.name: Rear Naked Choke
moves.text: Prerequisite: dominant position on the ground. Drains 3 Energy and inflicts the major tag Choked. If Energy drops below 0, the opponent is unconscious.

moves.name: Lingshu Nerve Strike
moves.text: Robs 3 Energy (breathlessness/paralysis) and inflicts the tag Paralyzed.

moves.name: Drunken Parry
moves.text: In an Exchange, turns the setback you suffer into a free counterattack that cannot be defended against.

moves.name: Shadow Double
moves.text: The next hit you would take (even on a Counter) strikes the clone and fizzles out. Declared before the Clash.

moves.name: Parkour Dropkick
moves.text: Prerequisite: height. Smashes shield/Protection and hits a second target.

moves.name: Qi Flow
moves.text: An ally gains +2 Energy (action, no Clash).

moves.name: Ricochet
moves.text: Ignores physical Cover (walls, shields) completely and hits a chosen zone.

moves.name: Iaijutsu Quickdraw
moves.text: Interrupt: an immediate counter action before the actual Clash begins. Declared before the Clash.

moves.name: Flashbang Breach
moves.text: Willpower damage to up to 3 enemies. Allies get +2 in the first Clash against the blinded enemies.

moves.name: Assassin's Strike
moves.text: Prerequisite: the opponent has not noticed you (Stealth Clash won, or a Goon struck from hiding). Injury even without Dominance, zone freely chosen.

moves.name: Shadow Step
moves.text: In a Stealth Clash, a Spotted result becomes Suspicion: you have vanished again into a cloud of smoke or around a corner.

moves.name: Lock Reversal
moves.text: Prerequisite: the opponent puts a joint lock or hold on you. Instantly removes the major tag (Joint Locked) and grants you a free counter action.

moves.name: Blowgun Dart
moves.text: A dart to the neck or face. If it hits an opponent without Protection (or on Dominance with an injury), they are Poisoned (strong, with a Delay of up to 3 rounds).

moves.name: Dokushu Touch
moves.text: A touch that slips past any armor: the poison (weak) works even through Protection.

moves.name: Garrote
moves.text: Prerequisite: unnoticed. Drains 4 Energy and inflicts the major tag Choked, silently. The victim cannot cry out.

moves.name: Touch of Death
moves.text: The touch finds every gap. On Dominance, the fight ends against all opponents at level 10 or lower. A stronger Boss loses Protection, 2 injuries and 3 WP, and the poison works anyway (antidote DC 13).

moves.name: Wick Flick
moves.text: Reloading and weapon swap mid-Clash, without the Reloading tag, as part of the attack. The shot goes into a chosen zone.

moves.name: Drum Flip
moves.text: Run up the wall, the bullets spill out of your cleavage, the drum catches them, and in a backflip the shot goes into up to 3 enemies. Reloading included.
